epics.title: Venue

tasks.title: Shortlist three venues

subtasks.title: Check accessibility
subtasks.description:
**Given** a shortlisted venue, **When** we ask about access, **Then** we know whether every guest can get in and around.

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Step-free entrance and an accessible toilet confirmed for each venue.

subtasks.title: Check capacity
subtasks.description:
**As an** event organiser, **I want** each venue's capacity confirmed **so that** all 60 guests fit comfortably.

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Standing and seated capacity recorded for each venue.

tasks.description:
**As an** event organiser, **I want** three venues to compare **so that** we can choose one that fits the budget and the guests.

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Three venues within an hour of the office are listed with price and capacity.
- [ ] Each is checked for step-free access.

tasks.title: Book venue
tasks.description:
**As an** event organiser, **I want** the chosen venue booked **so that** nobody else can take the date.

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Booking confirmed in writing for the agreed date.
- [ ] Deposit paid and receipt filed.

epics.description:
**As an** event organiser, **I want** a suitable venue booked **so that** the party has a confirmed place to happen.

### Definition of done
- [ ] A venue for 60 people is booked and the deposit paid.
- [ ] The booking confirmation is saved in the shared drive.

epics.title: Food and drink

tasks.title: Choose caterer
tasks.description:
**As an** event organiser, **I want** a caterer chosen **so that** food is arranged for the final headcount.

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Two quotes compared for the final headcount.
- [ ] Vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options confirmed.

epics.description:
**As a** guest, **I want** good food and drink at the party **so that** the evening is enjoyable.

### Definition of done
- [ ] A caterer is booked for the final headcount, with dietary needs covered.

tasks.title: Send save-the-date email
tasks.description:
**When** the date is fixed, **I want to** tell everyone straight away, **so I can** maximise attendance.

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Email sent to the whole office with the date and venue area.
